_meta.citation: EN 301 549 V3.2.1 — Accessibility requirements for ICT products and services
_meta.source_reachable: measured 2026-09-06 from this repo's network: HTTP 200, 2285361 bytes, application/pdf
blocked_on: May the requirement text be reproduced in this repository? The standard is published free of charge by CEN/CENELEC/ETSI and is reachable (above), so this is a question about REDISTRIBUTION, not access — the same shape as ADR 0053's question about the ITI VPAT template, and a question for counsel rather than engineering.
If the text may not be reproduced, may the clause NUMBERS and TITLES alone be? A VPAT's EU report needs a row per reportable clause; it does not need the normative prose.
_meta.why_this_file_exists: So the shape is agreed and the wiring is proven before the answer arrives. requirement_sets_available() reads this file and finds nothing to offer, which is the correct behaviour for a catalog with no requirements in it — see acr_catalog for why an empty catalog and an absent one are deliberately the same answer.

row_shape.num: the clause number as the standard writes it, e.g. "9.1.1.1" or "11.7"
row_shape.name: the clause title
row_shape.clause: the top-level clause this row belongs to, e.g. "9" — the EU report's tables are organised by clause the way the 508 report's are by chapter
row_shape.kind: "requirement" or "scope", matching config/section-508.json so one renderer can serve both

reportable_clauses.note: Recorded from the standard's own table of contents so the eventual parse has something to be checked against, NOT transcribed from its requirement text.
reportable_clauses.13: ICT providing relay or emergency service access
